Pop the back panel off. Then, remove the four screws on each side of the screen frame, making eight side screws in total.

Finish by replacing the two screws at the base of the bezel, then slide the battery back in until it clicks.

question: I'm following along to learn how to prepare a fish. Please guide me through each step as it happens.

ground_truth.response: Start by using a scaling tool to remove all the scales from the fish. Move the tool from the tail towards the head on both sides until smooth.
Switch to a sharp knife now. Cut along the belly to open the fish and carefully remove all the internal organs. Keep rinsing the fish with fresh water.
With the organs removed, perform final cleaning cuts to tidy up the interior. Trim away any excess bits and give the whole fish a thorough final rinse.
The preparation is complete. Carefully place the cleaned fish into a clear plastic bag to keep it fresh for storage or delivery.

question: I'm following along with this hair care routine for children. Please guide me through each step as it happens.

ground_truth.response: Start by applying shampoo to the wet hair and vigorously massage it into a thick, soapy lather across the child's entire head.
Now, use a handheld shower head to thoroughly rinse all the soap from the hair. Ensure all the lather is washed away before moving to styling.
Next, apply a hair moisturizer or detangling spray. Spray it evenly over the damp hair to make it easier to manage and style.
Finally, take a brush and gently comb through the hair, starting from the ends and working up to remove any remaining tangles.
